text:
```yaml
name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      runner-label:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "self-hosted"

jobs:
  cleanup:
    name: Pre-Checkout Cleanup
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-label }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Clean up workspace
        run: |
          # Remove previous build artifacts and caches to ensure a clean state
          # This replaces the aggressive root-privileged Docker cleanup with safe, user-level operations
          echo "Cleaning up workspace..."
          
          # Remove Python bytecode and cache directories
          find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find . -type f -name "*.pyc" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          find . -type f -name "*.pyo" -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          
          # Remove pytest cache
          rm -rf .pytest_cache 2>/dev/null || true
          
          # Remove Rust target directory if it exists (optional, depending on strategy)
          # rm -rf target 2>/dev/null || true
          
          # Remove any temporary files
          rm -rf .tox 2>/dev/null || true
          rm -rf .mypy_cache 2>/dev/null || true
          
          echo "Workspace cleanup completed."

      - name: Fix runner permissions
        if: hashFiles('scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh') != ''
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
          ./scripts/fix-runner-permissions.sh
```
